t: You've come to the Only Children's Bench, an artwork in the form of a bench, made by Pablo Reinoso. Reinoso is an Argentine-French artist and designer who has been working in Paris since 1978. It's a useful place to see how he blends sculpture with something practical, because this is both a seat and a piece of art. I don't have more detail on the story behind the name, so I'll leave you to look at its form and decide what you make of it.
